title: Research question to reproducible artifact
description: A compact synthetic eLearning V1.1 fixture for safe projection testing.
keyPoints: An artifact needs a replay path.

eLearning.stage: GĐ1 · Chuẩn bị tại Việt Nam
objectives: Create an experiment protocol that can be replayed.
prerequisites: A project topic and a note file
eLearning.whyItMatters: НИР/ВКР claims must remain tied to evidence and repeatable artifacts.
coreTheory: Question, method, data, metric and limitation form one evidence chain.

workedExample.question: Does detector A reduce false alarms on dataset D?
workedExample.verification: Compare against a declared baseline with a fixed split.

guidedPractice.task: Rewrite an unmeasurable topic as a measurable question.

checkpointQuestions.q: What binds a claim to a result?
checkpointQuestions.a: A declared method, dataset, metric and traceable artifact.

eLearning.baumanConnection: Supports Bauman ИУ-5 НИР/ВКР evidence and defense.
eLearning.reviewIfWrong: Return to the evidence chain and repair one missing link.
